# /crav1-fix-live

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: reference only · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-fix-live/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Shortcut to [`/crav1-fix-from-verify`](crav1-fix-from-verify.md) when the verify gap is a live/inner-loop path (ports, proxy, SQL, unpublished URL).

## Runs when

A live or untested wiring gap. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: The same queue as fix-from-verify.

Reads the same queue as [`/crav1-fix-from-verify`](crav1-fix-from-verify.md).

## Writes

In short: What [`/crav1-fix-from-verify`](crav1-fix-from-verify.md) writes.

Writes what that skill writes.

## Does not

Leaves `spec.md` alone.

Limits and exceptions: prefers live or untested wiring rows. When the fix changes how the parts connect, it asks once whether to run [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md) and does not run it.
